requirements.description: End customers browse, search, and purchase products on the platform.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal

requirements.description: Store managers view regional orders and manage returns via the platform.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal

requirements.description: Central admin team manages products, pricing, and promotions across the platform.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal

requirements.description: Vendor partners manage their own product listings and inventory via dedicated login.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal

requirements.description: Platform must go live within 6 months maximum from project start.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Platform is deployed and accessible to customers within 6 months.

requirements.description: System must support credit card payments for customer purchases.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Customer can successfully complete purchase using a credit card.

requirements.description: System must support credit card EMI payment option at checkout.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Customer can select credit card EMI and complete order successfully.

requirements.description: System must integrate with Bajaj Finance API for no-cost EMI financing.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Customer can select Bajaj Finance no-cost EMI and receive financing approval.

requirements.description: Bajaj Finance API integration is feasible given existing client agreement.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta

requirements.description: ZestMoney partnership agreement will be finalized before platform go-live.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta

requirements.description: System must provide separate login portal for vendor partners to manage listings.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Vendor can log in and access only their own product and inventory data.

requirements.description: Vendors must be able to manage product information and inventory via their portal.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Vendor can update product details and stock levels successfully.

requirements.description: Vendors cannot set product prices; only central admin controls all pricing.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Vendor portal has no price editing capability.

requirements.description: Store managers must view orders filtered by their geographic region.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Store manager sees only orders associated with their assigned region.

requirements.description: Store managers must be able to manage customer returns from their portal.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Store manager can initiate and process a return for a regional order.

requirements.description: System must support a product catalog of up to 25,000 SKUs.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Platform successfully loads and displays 25,000 SKUs without errors.

requirements.description: System must integrate with SAP ERP to migrate and sync product data.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Product data from SAP is successfully imported into the platform.

requirements.description: Inventory levels must sync with SAP in real time to prevent overselling.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Inventory update in SAP reflects on platform within 60 seconds.

requirements.description: Product information must sync from SAP via batch process once daily.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Product information batch sync from SAP completes successfully once per day.

requirements.description: System must provide product search by product name, category, and brand.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Customer can search by name, category, and brand and receive relevant results.

requirements.description: System must support product filtering by price range, brand, ratings, and delivery time.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Customer can apply all four filter types and results update accordingly.

requirements.description: Customers must be able to submit product reviews and ratings.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Customer can submit a review and rating for a purchased product.

requirements.description: Admin must moderate and approve customer reviews before they are published.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Review is not visible to customers until admin approves it.

requirements.description: Customers must be able to save products to a wishlist for later purchase.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Customer can add a product to wishlist and retrieve it in a later session.

requirements.description: System must integrate with Delhivery API for shipping rates and order tracking.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Shipping rates from Delhivery are displayed at checkout and tracking is available.

requirements.description: Customers must be able to track their orders in real time within the platform.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Customer can view live order tracking status on their order detail page.

requirements.description: All customer data must be stored on servers physically located within India.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Infrastructure audit confirms all data storage is within Indian data centers.

requirements.description: Platform must comply with GDPR regulations for NRI customer data handling.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: GDPR compliance audit passes with no critical findings.

requirements.description: Platform must comply with Indian Information Technology Act requirements.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Legal review confirms IT Act compliance before go-live.

requirements.description: Platform must handle at least 50,000 concurrent users during peak sale events.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Load test with 50,000 concurrent users completes without system failure.

requirements.description: All platform pages must load within 3 seconds under normal and peak conditions.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Performance test confirms page load time under 3 seconds at peak load.

requirements.description: System must generate sales reports on daily, weekly, and monthly intervals.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Admin can generate and download sales reports for each time period.

requirements.description: Sales reports must be filterable by region, product category, and vendor.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Admin can filter sales report by region, category, and vendor and get accurate results.

requirements.description: System must provide cart abandonment analytics showing products viewed but not purchased.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Analytics dashboard displays cart abandonment rate and associated products.

requirements.description: System must support sending promotional emails and SMS to customers.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Admin can create and send a promotional email and SMS campaign to customers.

requirements.description: Existing SAP ERP product data is clean and suitable for direct migration.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta

requirements.description: RetailCorp will provide SAP API credentials and access for integration development.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta

requirements.description: Delhivery and BlueDart API access will be provided by the client for integration.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal

requirements.description: 50,000 peak users is based on physical store footfall and may underestimate online traffic.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal

requirements.description: Platform must use SAP as the system of record for product and inventory data.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta

requirements.description: Products must not be displayed as available if inventory is zero in SAP.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Out-of-stock product shows unavailable status within real-time sync window.

requirements.description: System must be scalable to support catalog growth from 8,000 to 25,000 SKUs.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Platform performance remains within SLA after catalog expansion to 25,000 SKUs.

requirements.description: System must support a marketing tool or integration for email and SMS campaigns.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Marketing campaigns can be created and dispatched via email and SMS channels.

requirements.description: Platform must support role-based access control for customers, store managers, admins, and vendors.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Each user role can only access features and data permitted for their role.

requirements.description: Customer reviews must not be publicly visible until approved by an admin moderator.
requirements.speaker: Rajesh Mehta
acceptance_criteria: Submitted review remains hidden from public until admin approval action is taken.

requirements.description: RetailCorp will supply product images and content for initial catalog population.
Platform must maintain high availability during peak sale events such as Diwali.
requirements.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
acceptance_criteria: Platform uptime is 99.9% or above during designated sale event windows.

requirements.description: The system shall allow new customers to register using email or mobile number.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can successfully register with a valid email or mobile number and receive confirmation.

requirements.description: The system shall allow registered customers to log in via email/password or OTP.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can log in successfully using either email/password or a valid OTP.

requirements.description: The system shall allow customers to search products by name, brand, or category.
acceptance_criteria: Search returns relevant results when queried by product name, brand, or category.

requirements.description: The system shall allow customers to filter search results by price, brand, rating, and delivery time.
acceptance_criteria: Applying any filter updates search results to show only matching products.

requirements.description: The system shall display detailed product information including images, specs, and pricing.
acceptance_criteria: Product detail page shows images, description, price, availability, and ratings.

requirements.description: The system shall allow customers to add one or more products to a shopping cart.
acceptance_criteria: Selected products appear in the cart with correct quantities and prices.

requirements.description: The system shall allow customers to save products to a personal wishlist.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can add a product to wishlist and retrieve it in a later session.

requirements.description: The system shall allow customers to add and select a delivery address during checkout.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can save multiple addresses and select one as the delivery address at checkout.

requirements.description: The system shall support payment via credit card, debit card, UPI, net banking, and EMI.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can complete a purchase using any of the five supported payment methods.

requirements.description: The system shall provide customers with real-time order tracking after purchase.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can view live shipment status and estimated delivery time for placed orders.

requirements.description: The system shall allow customers who purchased a product to submit a review and rating.
acceptance_criteria: Only verified purchasers can submit a review; submission includes a star rating and text.

requirements.description: The system shall allow central admin to approve or reject customer reviews before publication.
acceptance_criteria: Reviews are only visible to other customers after admin explicitly approves them.

requirements.description: The system shall allow central admin to add, edit, and deactivate products in the catalog.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can create, update, and deactivate a product; deactivated products are hidden from customers.

requirements.description: The system shall allow central admin to set and update product prices and discounts.
acceptance_criteria: Updated prices and discounts are reflected on the product page immediately after admin saves changes.

requirements.description: The system shall sync inventory levels with SAP in real time to reflect accurate stock status.
acceptance_criteria: Out-of-stock products are marked unavailable on the platform within 60 seconds of SAP update.

requirements.description: The system shall allow vendors to create, update, and manage their product listings.
acceptance_criteria: Vendor can add, edit, and remove their own product listings via the vendor portal.

requirements.description: The system shall allow store managers to view all orders within their assigned region.
acceptance_criteria: Store manager dashboard displays only orders belonging to their designated region.

requirements.description: The system shall provide central admin with sales reports filterable by day, week, month, category, region, and vendor.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can generate and export a sales report using any combination of the supported filter dimensions.

requirements.description: The system shall report products added to cart but not purchased to central admin.
acceptance_criteria: Admin dashboard displays an abandoned-cart report listing products and abandonment counts.

requirements.description: The system shall allow central admin to send promotional campaigns to customers via email and SMS.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can create and dispatch a campaign; targeted customers receive the message via selected channel.

requirements.description: The system shall provide a fully functional mobile application for Android and iOS platforms.
acceptance_criteria: Customers can browse, search, and complete purchases on both Android and iOS native apps.

requirements.description: The system shall display key business metrics to executives via a mobile dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Executive mobile dashboard shows real-time KPIs including revenue, orders, and conversion rate.

requirements.description: The system shall allow customers to initiate a return request for a delivered product.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can submit a return request with reason; system acknowledges and initiates the refund process.

requirements.description: The system shall integrate with Delhivery and BlueDart APIs for shipping rate calculation and order tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Shipping rates are auto-calculated at checkout and tracking data is retrieved from Delhivery and BlueDart APIs.

glossary.ShopEase: The e-commerce platform being built for RetailCorp India Pvt. Ltd. to enable online retail sales
glossary.RetailCorp: The client organization, a mid-size Indian retail chain with approximately 200 physical stores across India
glossary.SKU: Stock Keeping Unit — a unique identifier for each distinct product variant in the catalog; platform must support up to 25,000
glossary.SAP ERP: RetailCorp's existing enterprise resource planning system serving as the system of record for product and inventory data
glossary.No-Cost EMI: An equated monthly installment option where the interest cost is absorbed by the retailer or financing partner, not the customer
glossary.Bajaj Finance: A third-party financing partner providing no-cost EMI services to customers, requiring API integration with the platform
glossary.ZestMoney: A second financing partner for no-cost EMI whose partnership agreement is pending finalization before go-live
glossary.Delhivery: A logistics partner whose API must be integrated for shipping rate calculation and real-time order tracking
glossary.Vendor Portal: A dedicated login interface allowing vendor partners to manage their own product listings and inventory independently
glossary.Central Admin: RetailCorp's internal team with exclusive control over pricing, promotions, and product moderation across the platform
glossary.Store Manager: A regional RetailCorp employee role with access to view orders and manage returns filtered by their geographic region
glossary.Cart Abandonment Analytics: A reporting feature tracking products that customers viewed or added to cart but did not purchase
glossary.Peak Sale Event: High-traffic promotional periods such as Diwali during which the platform must sustain 50,000 concurrent users
glossary.OTP: One-Time Password — a time-limited authentication code used for customer login via mobile number
glossary.Data Localisation: The regulatory requirement that all customer data be stored on servers physically located within India
